**Finding: deviation (LOL-CAP, critical)**

The Agreement has no limitation-of-liability section; the only cap sits at the end of the indemnity section (p0077) and is one-sided in TrueLink's favour:

- **Vendor capped, Customer uncapped** — TrueLink alone benefits from a 12-month compensation cap, while Mortgage Logic's liability, including the very broad Section 12a indemnity (Client breach, Web Site/Client Content, third-party injury), is unlimited. This is walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Vendor cap further narrowed** to matters under Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 only.
- **No mutual exclusion** of indirect/consequential damages anywhere in the document, and no carve-outs for confidentiality, data security, indemnities, fraud or IP infringement.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`) edits the single existing sentence to: a mutual, Agreement-wide cap at the greater of 12 months' hosting/support compensation and USD 1,000,000; a mutual consequential-damages exclusion; an "Excluded Claims" super-cap carve-out (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement); and confirmation that Client's payment obligations fall outside the limitation. The comment offers a straight mutual 12-month fee cap with those carve-outs as the fallback.
